address: Route de la Corniche 4, Chexbres, 1070, Switzerland
bio: The restaurant is part of Le Baron Tavernier, the chic little spa hotel opposite, and boasts a magnificent location with panoramic views. In addition to a fabulous vista over Lake Geneva, this place promises ambitious and tasteful French cuisine, prepared with top-notch produce, as well as friendly and attentive service. In summer, the open-air bar is the perfect spot for a drink....
